about_the_game:
Astrolite is a fast-paced survival roguelite which takes place in space. Fight across the solar system annihilating the world guardians defending their planets against you in a conquest to eliminate all life at any cost. Upgrade unique weapons and develop interesting playstyle combinations to aid in defeating a relentless onslaught of asteroids attempting to stop you. 

  • Auto-firing weapons with manual aiming

  • Fast runs ( < 30 minutes )

  • Collect XP Orbs to level up, selecting over 12 passives to empower you

  • Utilize over 15 unique weapons with style-specific tags

  • Upgrade weapons and passives an unlimited amount of times

  • Unlock characters with vastly different playstyles

  • Fight against over 16 unique asteroids, 6 bosses, and 9 World Guardians all tied to respective planets

  • Survive on planets for 180 seconds in a bullet heaven style, destroying as many asteroids as possible

  • Defeat bosses defending each planet one-on-one at the end of survivals in a bullet hell styled arena

  • Fighter

    Passive: Gain bonus penetration across all weapons

    Ability: Unleash a death blossom of bullets to annihilate every opponent in your way

    Power: Engage turbo thrusters to rapidly dodge

  • Chemist 

    Passive: Gain bonus bullet size across all weapons

    Ability: Empower all weapons to apply stacking shards into enemies, which can detonate for massive damage

    Power: Prematurely detonate every embedded shard that exists on the map, causing widespread damage

  • Vampire 

    Passive: Occasionally restore health after defeating enemies at the cost of disabled health regeneration

    Ability: Awaken into a true vampire, gaining massive stat bonuses and regenerating health at an alarming rate

    Power: Summon an aura that deals periodic damage, and shreds enemy armor- defeated enemies within the aura are guaranteed to restore health

  • Mage

    Passive: Gain bonus bullet speed across all weapons

    Ability: Expel a dying star onto the map, which rapidly releases projectiles that seek out and destroy enemies

    Power: Control the flow of time, reducing the speed at which all enemies perform
